agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has large dt 0.0194 near max, seeded sensor_noise 0.0145, initial v -0.307. Noisy angle measurement drives high-gain state feedback at coarse timestep causing large forces >30N that pump energy. Theta diverges from -0.03 rad at step 30 to -0.85 rad at step 34 with omega -12.3 rad/s. Cart velocity reaches 7.5 m/s. Removing sensor_noise alone (counterfactual s2c3d9f5f09) makes run pass with no violations, proving noise+large dt is causal.
